newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-KLINSMANN REJECTS OFFERS TO RETURN TO ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KLINSMANN REJECTS OFFERS TO RETURN TO ENGLAND.

text.p: Juergen Klinsmann said on Friday he had received offers to return to England, where he spent a successful season with Tottenham Hotspur but rejected them to concentrate on winning the German title with Bayern Munich.

Bayern top the Bundesliga at the halfway stage this season. Klinsmann said a national title was very important to him as he had never won one in an otherwise glittering career which included World Cup and European championship triumphs.
"A few inquiries came from England but I rejected them all flatly," Klinsmann told German sports agency SID in an interview. "I haven't thought about where I might go later."
The Germany captain has said he will leave Bayern at the end of the season if they do not change their style of play, which he regards as too defensive.

Some press reports suggested he might go even sooner than the summer and linked him with English clubs such as Nottingham Forest, Blackburn Rovers and Everton. Klinsmann did not name the clubs who had made inquiries about him.
"My entire concentration is fixed on the German championship and the German cup," he said. "The championship title is really important for me as I haven't won one yet."

He said he would review the situation in a few months but added he was also hopeful Bayern would play more attacking soccer now creative midfielders Mario Basler and Mehmet Scholl were free of injuries which sidelined them earlier this season.
